articles.headline: Meta expands Muse to small businesses
articles.summary: Meta’s expansion signals another push to make agentic AI available to smaller firms, not just large enterprises. That could affect marketing workflows, customer engagement, and automation budgets for SMEs evaluating practical AI tools.

articles.headline: Micron says memory demand is surging as AI data-center commitments climb
articles.summary: Micron reported record results and said customer commitments under long-term agreements rose sharply, signaling tighter memory supply for AI infrastructure. For businesses, this points to higher costs and longer lead times for servers, storage, and AI deployments as demand outstrips supply.

articles.headline: U.S. authorities charge alleged scheme to smuggle export-controlled Nvidia GPUs into China
articles.summary: The DOJ case highlights continued enforcement risk around advanced-chip exports and re-exports tied to China. Businesses in semiconductors, logistics, and global technology supply chains should expect heightened compliance scrutiny and potential disruption.
